SOURCE_COMMIT: 39c267a2fabfb0cd6d94f4dd86b23b4750328dd5
SOURCE_PATH: wa-apps/team/lib/classes/teamUser.class.php::keepVisible

Full Team admin: keep every candidate.
Self: always visible.
Non-self user with no groups: visible.
Grouped user: visible when at least one group is not hidden.
Hidden groups: manage_users_in_group.* effective value < 0.
If every target group is hidden: omit user.
